### Census.lean

~~~~~lean file=Census.lean
/-
  THE CENSUS · the conservation of count, proved in general. Core Lean 4.19.0, no library, no axiom declared.

  The RA_TOE thesis executed C × F = v³ on the coordinate-cut tower for v = 2..5 and recorded the general law as
  "instanced, never proven". This file proves it for every finite carrier, every map, every v, every n, every cut.

  I   Conservation. For any map on any finite list of states, the fibres over the distinct images sum to the whole:
      nothing a cut removes from content is lost; it reappears as freedom.
  II  Uniform fibres. Where every fibre has the same size F, content × freedom = the whole.
  III The tower. Cutting a of n coordinates over v values: content v^(n-a), freedom v^a, product v^n, for all v, n, a.
  IV  The bit. With the whole fixed, halving the content doubles the freedom exactly: one bit leaves the content
      and one bit enters the freedom. This is the Second Law in counting form, from the census alone.
  V   The direction. Composing cuts never shrinks a fibre: freedom does not decrease along the arrow.
  VI  Irreversibility. A map that merges two states has no left inverse.
  VII Symmetric price. Erasing a bit toward either value merges the same two states: assent and denial pay alike.

  The logarithm of the factor two is ln 2; k_B and T enter only as units. No thermodynamic premise appears here.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace Census

/-! ## the carriers -/
def tot : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | a :: r => a + tot r

/-- The fibre of `f` over `y` inside the states `xs`: how many states the cut sends to `y`. -/
def cnt {α β : Type} [DecidableEq β] (f : α → β) (y : β) : List α → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | x :: r => (if f x = y then 1 else 0) + cnt f y r

/-- Distinctness of a list of contents. -/
def ND {β : Type} : List β → Prop
  | [] => True
  | y :: r => y ∉ r ∧ ND r

theorem tot_map_add {β : Type} (g h : β → Nat) :
    ∀ ys : List β, tot (ys.map fun y => g y + h y) = tot (ys.map g) + tot (ys.map h)
  | [] => rfl
  | y :: r => by
    show g y + h y + tot (r.map fun y => g y + h y) = (g y + tot (r.map g)) + (h y + tot (r.map h))
    rw [tot_map_add g h r]; omega

theorem tot_map_zero {β : Type} : ∀ ys : List β, tot (ys.map fun _ => 0) = 0
  | [] => rfl
  | _ :: r => by show 0 + tot (r.map fun _ => 0) = 0; rw [tot_map_zero r]

theorem tot_indicator_absent {β : Type} [DecidableEq β] (b : β) :
    ∀ ys : List β, b ∉ ys → tot (ys.map fun y => if b = y then 1 else 0) = 0
  | [] => fun _ => rfl
  | y :: r => fun h => by
    have hy : b ≠ y := fun e => h (e ▸ List.Mem.head r)
    have hr : b ∉ r := fun m => h (List.Mem.tail y m)
    show (if b = y then 1 else 0) + tot (r.map fun y => if b = y then 1 else 0) = 0
    rw [if_neg hy, tot_indicator_absent b r hr]

theorem tot_indicator_one {β : Type} [DecidableEq β] (b : β) :
    ∀ ys : List β, ND ys → b ∈ ys → tot (ys.map fun y => if b = y then 1 else 0) = 1
  | [] => fun _ m => nomatch m
  | y :: r => fun hnd m => by
    show (if b = y then 1 else 0) + tot (r.map fun y => if b = y then 1 else 0) = 1
    by_cases hy : b = y
    · rw [if_pos hy, tot_indicator_absent b r (hy ▸ hnd.1)]
    · rw [if_neg hy]
      have mr : b ∈ r := by
        cases m with
        | head => exact absurd rfl hy
        | tail _ h => exact h
      rw [tot_indicator_one b r hnd.2 mr]

/-! ## I · conservation, for every map on every finite carrier -/

/-- THE CENSUS. Over any list of distinct contents that covers the image, the fibres sum to the whole. -/
theorem census_conservation_rec {α β : Type} [DecidableEq β] (f : α → β) :
    ∀ (xs : List α) (ys : List β), ND ys → (∀ x ∈ xs, f x ∈ ys) →
      tot (ys.map fun y => cnt f y xs) = xs.length
  | [], ys, _, _ => tot_map_zero ys
  | x :: r, ys, hnd, hcov => by
    have hx : f x ∈ ys := hcov x (List.Mem.head r)
    have hr : ∀ z ∈ r, f z ∈ ys := fun z hz => hcov z (List.Mem.tail x hz)
    show tot (ys.map fun y => (if f x = y then 1 else 0) + cnt f y r) = r.length + 1
    rw [tot_map_add (fun y => if f x = y then 1 else 0) (fun y => cnt f y r) ys,
        tot_indicator_one (f x) ys hnd hx, census_conservation_rec f r ys hnd hr]
    omega

theorem census_conservation {α β : Type} [DecidableEq β] (f : α → β) :
    ∀ (xs : List α) (ys : List β), ND ys → (∀ x ∈ xs, f x ∈ ys) →
      tot (ys.map fun y => cnt f y xs) = xs.length :=
  fun xs ys hnd hcov => census_conservation_rec f xs ys hnd hcov

/-! ## II · uniform fibres: content times freedom is the whole -/

theorem tot_map_const {β : Type} (g : β → Nat) (F : Nat) :
    ∀ ys : List β, (∀ y ∈ ys, g y = F) → tot (ys.map g) = ys.length * F
  | [] => fun _ => by simp [tot]
  | y :: r => fun h => by
    show g y + tot (r.map g) = (r.length + 1) * F
    rw [h y (List.Mem.head r), tot_map_const g F r (fun z hz => h z (List.Mem.tail y hz)),
        Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_comm]

theorem census_uniform {α β : Type} [DecidableEq β] (f : α → β) (xs : List α) (ys : List β) (F : Nat)
    (hnd : ND ys) (hcov : ∀ x ∈ xs, f x ∈ ys) (hunif : ∀ y ∈ ys, cnt f y xs = F) :
    ys.length * F = xs.length := by
  rw [← tot_map_const (fun y => cnt f y xs) F ys hunif]
  exact census_conservation f xs ys hnd hcov

/-! ## III · the cut of a product, and the tower for every v, n, a -/

/-- All pairs of a kept configuration and a cut configuration. -/
def pr {α γ : Type} : List α → List γ → List (α × γ)
  | [], _ => []
  | a :: as, B => B.map (fun b => (a, b)) ++ pr as B

theorem len_pr {α γ : Type} (B : List γ) : ∀ A : List α, (pr A B).length = A.length * B.length
  | [] => by simp [pr]
  | a :: as => by
    show (B.map (fun b => (a, b)) ++ pr as B).length = (as.length + 1) * B.length
    rw [List.length_append, List.length_map, len_pr B as, Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_comm]

theorem cnt_append {α β : Type} [DecidableEq β] (f : α → β) (y : β) :
    ∀ L M : List α, cnt f y (L ++ M) = cnt f y L + cnt f y M
  | [], M => by simp [cnt]
  | x :: r, M => by
    show (if f x = y then 1 else 0) + cnt f y (r ++ M) = ((if f x = y then 1 else 0) + cnt f y r) + cnt f y M
    rw [cnt_append f y r M]; omega

theorem cnt_fst_row {α γ : Type} [DecidableEq α] (a k : α) :
    ∀ B : List γ, cnt Prod.fst k (B.map fun b => (a, b)) = if a = k then B.length else 0
  | [] => by by_cases h : a = k <;> simp [cnt, h]
  | b :: r => by
    show (if a = k then 1 else 0) + cnt Prod.fst k (r.map fun b => (a, b)) = if a = k then r.length + 1 else 0
    rw [cnt_fst_row a k r]; by_cases h : a = k <;> simp [h]; omega

theorem cnt_fst_pr {α γ : Type} [DecidableEq α] (k : α) (B : List γ) :
    ∀ A : List α, ND A → k ∈ A → cnt Prod.fst k (pr A B) = B.length
  | [], _, m => nomatch m
  | a :: as, hnd, m => by
    show cnt Prod.fst k (B.map (fun b => (a, b)) ++ pr as B) = B.length
    rw [cnt_append, cnt_fst_row a k B]
    by_cases h : a = k
    · subst h
      have z : cnt Prod.fst a (pr as B) = 0 := by
        have : ∀ L : List α, a ∉ L → cnt Prod.fst a (pr L B) = 0 := by
          intro L
          induction L with
          | nil => intro _; rfl
          | cons c cs ih =>
            intro hn
            have hc : c ≠ a := fun e => hn (e ▸ List.Mem.head cs)
            have hcs : a ∉ cs := fun mm => hn (List.Mem.tail c mm)
            show cnt Prod.fst a (B.map (fun b => (c, b)) ++ pr cs B) = 0
            rw [cnt_append, cnt_fst_row c a B, if_neg hc, ih hcs]
        exact this as hnd.1
      rw [if_pos rfl, z, Nat.add_zero]
    · rw [if_neg h]
      have mr : k ∈ as := by
        cases m with
        | head => exact absurd rfl h
        | tail _ hh => exact hh
      rw [cnt_fst_pr k B as hnd.2 mr]; omega

theorem fst_mem_pr {α γ : Type} (B : List γ) : ∀ (A : List α) (p : α × γ), p ∈ pr A B → p.1 ∈ A
  | [], _, m => nomatch m
  | a :: as, p, m => by
    have m' : p ∈ B.map (fun b => (a, b)) ∨ p ∈ pr as B := List.mem_append.mp m
    cases m' with
    | inl h =>
      obtain ⟨b, _, e⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
      rw [← e]; exact List.Mem.head as
    | inr h => exact List.Mem.tail a (fst_mem_pr B as p h)

/-- THE CUT CENSUS. Cutting a product to its kept part: every fibre is the whole cut part, and content times
    freedom is the whole. -/
theorem census_cut {α γ : Type} [DecidableEq α] (A : List α) (B : List γ) (hnd : ND A) :
    (∀ k ∈ A, cnt Prod.fst k (pr A B) = B.length) ∧ A.length * B.length = (pr A B).length :=
  ⟨fun k m => cnt_fst_pr k B A hnd m,
   census_uniform Prod.fst (pr A B) A B.length hnd (fun p m => fst_mem_pr B A p m)
     (fun k m => cnt_fst_pr k B A hnd m)⟩

/-- The values 0..v-1. -/
def upto : Nat → List Nat
  | 0 => []
  | n + 1 => n :: upto n

theorem upto_lt : ∀ v x, x ∈ upto v → x < v
  | 0, _, m => nomatch m
  | v + 1, x, m => by
    cases m with
    | head => omega
    | tail _ h => have := upto_lt v x h; omega

theorem nd_upto : ∀ v, ND (upto v)
  | 0 => trivial
  | v + 1 => ⟨fun m => by have := upto_lt v v m; omega, nd_upto v⟩

theorem len_upto : ∀ v, (upto v).length = v
  | 0 => rfl
  | v + 1 => by show (upto v).length + 1 = v + 1; rw [len_upto v]

/-- One more coordinate: prefix every configuration with every value. -/
def layer : List Nat → List (List Nat) → List (List Nat)
  | [], _ => []
  | d :: ds, T => T.map (fun t => d :: t) ++ layer ds T

/-- All configurations of n coordinates over v values. -/
def tup (v : Nat) : Nat → List (List Nat)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | n + 1 => layer (upto v) (tup v n)

theorem len_layer (T : List (List Nat)) : ∀ ds : List Nat, (layer ds T).length = ds.length * T.length
  | [] => by simp [layer]
  | d :: ds => by
    show (T.map (fun t => d :: t) ++ layer ds T).length = (ds.length + 1) * T.length
    rw [List.length_append, List.length_map, len_layer T ds, Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_comm]

theorem len_tup (v : Nat) : ∀ n, (tup v n).length = v ^ n
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
    show (layer (upto v) (tup v n)).length = v ^ (n + 1)
    rw [len_layer, len_upto, len_tup v n, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]

theorem head_mem_layer (T : List (List Nat)) : ∀ (ds : List Nat) (x : List Nat), x ∈ layer ds T →
    ∃ d, d ∈ ds ∧ ∃ t, x = d :: t
  | [], _, m => nomatch m
  | d :: ds, x, m => by
    cases List.mem_append.mp m with
    | inl h =>
      obtain ⟨t, _, e⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
      exact ⟨d, List.Mem.head ds, t, e.symm⟩
    | inr h =>
      obtain ⟨d', hd', t, e⟩ := head_mem_layer T ds x h
      exact ⟨d', List.Mem.tail d hd', t, e⟩

theorem nd_map_cons (d : Nat) : ∀ T : List (List Nat), ND T → ND (T.map fun t => d :: t)
  | [], _ => trivial
  | t :: r, h => by
    refine ⟨fun m => ?_, nd_map_cons d r h.2⟩
    obtain ⟨t', ht', e⟩ := List.mem_map.mp m
    have : t' = t := List.cons.inj e |>.2
    exact h.1 (this ▸ ht')

theorem nd_append {β : Type} : ∀ L M : List β, ND L → ND M → (∀ x ∈ L, x ∉ M) → ND (L ++ M)
  | [], _, _, hM, _ => hM
  | y :: r, M, hL, hM, hdis => by
    refine ⟨fun m => ?_, nd_append r M hL.2 hM (fun x hx => hdis x (List.Mem.tail y hx))⟩
    cases List.mem_append.mp m with
    | inl h => exact hL.1 h
    | inr h => exact hdis y (List.Mem.head r) h

theorem nd_layer (T : List (List Nat)) (hT : ND T) : ∀ ds : List Nat, ND ds → ND (layer ds T)
  | [], _ => trivial
  | d :: ds, hds => by
    show ND (T.map (fun t => d :: t) ++ layer ds T)
    refine nd_append _ _ (nd_map_cons d T hT) (nd_layer T hT ds hds.2) (fun x hx hx2 => ?_)
    obtain ⟨t, _, e⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
    obtain ⟨d', hd', t', e'⟩ := head_mem_layer T ds x hx2
    rw [← e] at e'
    have : d = d' := (List.cons.inj e').1
    exact hds.1 (this ▸ hd')

theorem nd_tup (v : Nat) : ∀ n, ND (tup v n)
  | 0 => ⟨(fun m => nomatch m), trivial⟩
  | n + 1 => nd_layer (tup v n) (nd_tup v n) (upto v) (nd_upto v)

/-- THE TOWER, IN GENERAL. For every number of values v, every number of coordinates n and every cut a ≤ n: the
    content is v^(n-a) distinct configurations, every fibre holds v^a states, and content × freedom = v^n. The thesis
    executed this for v = 2..5 and n = 3; here it holds for all. -/
theorem census_tower (v n a : Nat) (ha : a ≤ n) :
    ND (tup v (n - a)) ∧
    (tup v (n - a)).length = v ^ (n - a) ∧
    (∀ k ∈ tup v (n - a), cnt Prod.fst k (pr (tup v (n - a)) (tup v a)) = v ^ a) ∧
    v ^ (n - a) * v ^ a = v ^ n ∧
    (pr (tup v (n - a)) (tup v a)).length = v ^ n := by
  have hc := census_cut (tup v (n - a)) (tup v a) (nd_tup v (n - a))
  have hpow : v ^ (n - a) * v ^ a = v ^ n := by rw [← Nat.pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel ha]
  refine ⟨nd_tup v (n - a), len_tup v (n - a), fun k m => ?_, hpow, ?_⟩
  · rw [hc.1 k m, len_tup]
  · rw [← hc.2, len_tup, len_tup, hpow]

/-! ## IV · the bit: what leaves the content enters the freedom -/

/-- THE SECOND LAW, IN COUNTING FORM. With the whole fixed, a cut that halves the content doubles the freedom
    exactly. One bit leaves the content, one bit enters the freedom; the total is conserved. The logarithm of this
    factor two is ln 2. -/
theorem bit_moves_to_freedom (N C F C' F' : Nat) (h1 : C * F = N) (h2 : C' * F' = N)
    (hhalf : C = 2 * C') (hpos : 0 < C') : F' = 2 * F := by
  have : C' * F' = C' * (2 * F) := by
    rw [h2, ← h1, hhalf, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_left_comm]
  exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hpos this

/-! ## V · the direction: freedom never shrinks along the arrow -/

/-- Composing a further cut never shrinks a fibre: every state in the fibre of `f` over `y` lies in the fibre of
    `g ∘ f` over `g y`. Freedom does not decrease along the arrow. -/
theorem freedom_never_shrinks_rec {α β δ : Type} [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq δ] (f : α → β) (g : β → δ) (y : β) :
    ∀ xs : List α, cnt f y xs ≤ cnt (fun x => g (f x)) (g y) xs
  | [] => Nat.le_refl 0
  | x :: r => by
    show (if f x = y then 1 else 0) + cnt f y r ≤ (if g (f x) = g y then 1 else 0) + cnt (fun x => g (f x)) (g y) r
    have ih := freedom_never_shrinks_rec f g y r
    by_cases h : f x = y
    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (by rw [h])]; omega
    · rw [if_neg h]; by_cases h' : g (f x) = g y
      · rw [if_pos h']; omega
      · rw [if_neg h']; omega

theorem freedom_never_shrinks {α β δ : Type} [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq δ] (f : α → β) (g : β → δ) (y : β) :
    ∀ xs : List α, cnt f y xs ≤ cnt (fun x => g (f x)) (g y) xs :=
  fun xs => freedom_never_shrinks_rec f g y xs

/-! ## VI · irreversibility: a merge has no inverse -/

theorem merge_irreversible {α β : Type} (f : α → β) (x₁ x₂ : α) (hne : x₁ ≠ x₂) (hmerge : f x₁ = f x₂) :
    ¬ ∃ g : β → α, ∀ x, g (f x) = x := by
  intro ⟨g, hg⟩
  apply hne
  rw [← hg x₁, ← hg x₂, hmerge]

/-! ## VII · the price is symmetric: assent and denial erase the same bit -/

/-- Erasing a bit toward either value merges the same two states into one fibre of two, and neither erasure has an
    inverse. The price of committing the bit does not depend on which way it is committed. -/
theorem price_symmetric (c : Bool) :
    cnt (fun _ : Bool => c) c [true, false] = 2 ∧ ¬ ∃ g : Bool → Bool, ∀ x, g ((fun _ : Bool => c) x) = x :=
  ⟨by cases c <;> rfl, merge_irreversible (fun _ : Bool => c) true false (by decide) rfl⟩

/-! ## the census, whole -/
theorem the_census :
    (∀ {α β : Type} [DecidableEq β] (f : α → β) (xs : List α) (ys : List β), ND ys → (∀ x ∈ xs, f x ∈ ys) →
      tot (ys.map fun y => cnt f y xs) = xs.length) ∧
    (∀ v n a : Nat, a ≤ n → v ^ (n - a) * v ^ a = v ^ n ∧
      ∀ k ∈ tup v (n - a), cnt Prod.fst k (pr (tup v (n - a)) (tup v a)) = v ^ a) ∧
    (∀ N C F C' F' : Nat, C * F = N → C' * F' = N → C = 2 * C' → 0 < C' → F' = 2 * F) ∧
    (∀ c : Bool, cnt (fun _ : Bool => c) c [true, false] = 2) :=
  ⟨fun f xs ys hnd hcov => census_conservation f xs ys hnd hcov,
   fun v n a ha => ⟨(census_tower v n a ha).2.2.2.1, (census_tower v n a ha).2.2.1⟩,
   bit_moves_to_freedom,
   fun c => (price_symmetric c).1⟩

end Census

#print axioms Census.census_conservation
#print axioms Census.census_uniform
#print axioms Census.census_cut
#print axioms Census.nd_tup
#print axioms Census.census_tower
#print axioms Census.bit_moves_to_freedom
#print axioms Census.freedom_never_shrinks

### Heat_Bridge.lean

~~~~~lean file=Heat_Bridge.lean
/-
  FROM COUNT TO HEAT, FROM THE SEAT. Core Lean 4.19.0, no library, no axiom declared.
  The step the 1.0.1p file carried as the Boltzmann bridge, hunted at theorem grade. Nothing is imported from
  Boltzmann; four facts replace him, three proved here and one posited and named.
  I   PIGEONHOLE. Distinct things landing in M cells number at most M. (proved)
  II  THE LOG IS FORCED. A measure of freedom that adds when independent freedoms multiply, which is the census's
      product law, is linear in the cut coordinates: f(v^a) = a f(v). Fixing f(2) = 1 makes it the bit count.
      The logarithm is not a choice; only its unit is. (proved)
  III THE EXPORT. If the whole evolves without merging (P1), halving the content forces the freedom elsewhere to at
      least double: one bit leaves, at least one bit arrives. (proved from P1)
  IV  THE PRICE. Temperature is energy per unit of freedom (the definition of T, a unit); k_B and ln 2 are SI units.
      The exported bit then costs at least k_B T ln 2. (proved; the constants are definitions)
  P1, the only posit: the whole merges no two states. Ancient as ex nihilo nihil fit; read here as the Root Axiom's
  no-cessation, premise grade. Nothing else is assumed.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace Heat

/-! ## I · pigeonhole, in core -/
def ND : List Nat → Prop
  | [] => True
  | x :: r => x ∉ r ∧ ND r

def AllLt (M : Nat) : List Nat → Prop
  | [] => True
  | x :: r => x < M ∧ AllLt M r

theorem allLt_mem (M : Nat) : ∀ (l : List Nat) (y : Nat), AllLt M l → y ∈ l → y < M
  | [], _, _, m => nomatch m
  | x :: r, y, h, m => by
    cases m with
    | head => exact h.1
    | tail _ hm => exact allLt_mem M r y h.2 hm

theorem nd_map (h : Nat → Nat) : ∀ l : List Nat, ND l → (∀ a ∈ l, ∀ b ∈ l, h a = h b → a = b) → ND (l.map h)
  | [], _, _ => trivial
  | x :: r, hnd, hinj => by
    refine ⟨fun m => ?_, nd_map h r hnd.2 (fun a ha b hb e => hinj a (List.Mem.tail x ha) b (List.Mem.tail x hb) e)⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, e⟩ := List.mem_map.mp m
    have : y = x := hinj y (List.Mem.tail x hy) x (List.Mem.head r) e
    exact hnd.1 (this ▸ hy)

theorem allLt_map (h : Nat → Nat) (M : Nat) : ∀ l : List Nat, (∀ a ∈ l, h a < M) → AllLt M (l.map h)
  | [], _ => trivial
  | x :: r, hb => ⟨hb x (List.Mem.head r), allLt_map h M r (fun a ha => hb a (List.Mem.tail x ha))⟩

/-- THE PIGEONHOLE: distinct numbers all below M number at most M. -/
theorem pigeonhole_rec : ∀ (l : List Nat) (M : Nat), ND l → AllLt M l → l.length ≤ M
  | [], _, _, _ => Nat.zero_le _
  | x :: r, M, hnd, hlt => by
    have hx : x < M := hlt.1
    let sw : Nat → Nat := fun y => if y = M - 1 then x else y
    have hbound : ∀ a ∈ r, sw a < M - 1 := by
      intro a ha
      have haM := allLt_mem M r a hlt.2 ha
      have hax : a ≠ x := fun e => hnd.1 (e ▸ ha)
      show (if a = M - 1 then x else a) < M - 1
      by_cases e : a = M - 1
      · rw [if_pos e]
        have : x ≠ M - 1 := fun e2 => hax (e.trans e2.symm)
        omega
      · rw [if_neg e]; omega
    have hinj : ∀ a ∈ r, ∀ b ∈ r, sw a = sw b → a = b := by
      intro a ha b hb e
      have hax : a ≠ x := fun e2 => hnd.1 (e2 ▸ ha)
      have hbx : b ≠ x := fun e2 => hnd.1 (e2 ▸ hb)
      change (if a = M - 1 then x else a) = (if b = M - 1 then x else b) at e
      by_cases ea : a = M - 1 <;> by_cases eb : b = M - 1
      · rw [ea, eb]
      · rw [if_pos ea, if_neg eb] at e; exact absurd e.symm hbx
      · rw [if_neg ea, if_pos eb] at e; exact absurd e hax
      · rw [if_neg ea, if_neg eb] at e; exact e
    have ih := pigeonhole_rec (r.map sw) (M - 1) (nd_map sw r hnd.2 hinj) (allLt_map sw (M - 1) r hbound)
    rw [List.length_map] at ih
    show r.length + 1 ≤ M
    omega

theorem pigeonhole : ∀ (l : List Nat) (M : Nat), ND l → AllLt M l → l.length ≤ M :=
  fun l M hnd hlt => pigeonhole_rec l M hnd hlt

/-! ## II · the log is forced -/
/-- A measure of freedom that adds when freedoms multiply is linear on the census tower. -/
theorem additive_is_linear_rec (f : Nat → Nat) (hmul : ∀ m n, f (m * n) = f m + f n) (v : Nat) :
    ∀ a, f (v ^ a) = a * f v
  | 0 => by
    have h := hmul 1 1
    show f 1 = 0 * f v
    rw [Nat.mul_one] at h; rw [Nat.zero_mul]; omega
  | a + 1 => by
    rw [Nat.pow_succ, hmul, additive_is_linear_rec f hmul v a, Nat.succ_mul]

theorem additive_is_linear_on_tower (f : Nat → Nat) (hmul : ∀ m n, f (m * n) = f m + f n) (v : Nat) :
    ∀ a, f (v ^ a) = a * f v :=
  fun a => additive_is_linear_rec f hmul v a

/-- The unit is the only choice: two additive measures that agree at v agree on the whole tower. -/
theorem log_unique_up_to_unit (f g : Nat → Nat) (hf : ∀ m n, f (m * n) = f m + f n)
    (hg : ∀ m n, g (m * n) = g m + g n) (v : Nat) (h : f v = g v) : ∀ a, f (v ^ a) = g (v ^ a) :=
  fun a => by rw [additive_is_linear_on_tower f hf v a, additive_is_linear_on_tower g hg v a, h]

/-- Fixing f 2 = 1 makes the measure the bit count on binary freedom. -/
theorem bits_forced (f : Nat → Nat) (hmul : ∀ m n, f (m * n) = f m + f n) (h2 : f 2 = 1) :
    ∀ a, f (2 ^ a) = a :=
  fun a => by rw [additive_is_linear_on_tower f hmul 2 a, h2, Nat.mul_one]

/-! ## III · the export -/
/-- Under P1 the whole's distinct states map injectively into the content-freedom cells after the step, so the
    whole's count before is at most the product after. -/
theorem whole_bounded (L : List Nat) (step : Nat → Nat) (C' F' : Nat) (hnd : ND L)
    (P1 : ∀ a ∈ L, ∀ b ∈ L, step a = step b → a = b) (cells : ∀ a ∈ L, step a < C' * F') :
    L.length ≤ C' * F' := by
  have := pigeonhole (L.map step) (C' * F') (nd_map step L hnd P1) (allLt_map step _ L cells)
  rwa [List.length_map] at this

/-- THE EXPORT. The whole was C × F; the step merges nothing; the content halves. The freedom after at least doubles. -/
theorem export_doubles (L : List Nat) (step : Nat → Nat) (C F C' F' : Nat) (hnd : ND L)
    (hwhole : L.length = C * F) (P1 : ∀ a ∈ L, ∀ b ∈ L, step a = step b → a = b)
    (cells : ∀ a ∈ L, step a < C' * F') (hhalf : C = 2 * C') (hpos : 0 < C') : 2 * F ≤ F' := by
  have hb := whole_bounded L step C' F' hnd P1 cells
  rw [hwhole, hhalf, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_left_comm] at hb
  exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left hb hpos

theorem pow2_mono_inv (b b' : Nat) (h : 2 ^ b < 2 ^ b') : b < b' := by
  refine Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hle => ?_
  have := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide : 0 < 2) hle
  omega

/-- In bits: at least one bit arrives in the freedom for the one bit that left the content. -/
theorem one_bit_arrives (b b' : Nat) (h : 2 * 2 ^ b ≤ 2 ^ b') : b + 1 ≤ b' := by
  have : 2 ^ b < 2 ^ b' := by
    have := Nat.pow_pos (n := b) (by decide : 0 < 2)
    omega
  exact pow2_mono_inv b b' this

/-! ## IV · the price -/
/-- k_B T ln 2 per bit in units of 10⁻⁴⁵ J, the constants of Armed_Seat and the codex: k_B = 1380649·10⁻²⁹ J/K
    exact (SI 2019, the definition of the kelvin), ln 2 to sixteen digits (the nat-to-bit unit). T is energy per
    unit of freedom, the definition of temperature. -/
def price (tkel bits : Nat) : Nat := bits * 1380649 * tkel * 6931471805599453

theorem price_monotone (tkel : Nat) (b b' : Nat) (h : b ≤ b') : price tkel b ≤ price tkel b' := by
  unfold price
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h))

/-- FROM COUNT TO HEAT. The whole's distinct states before are C × F with F = 2^b; the step merges nothing (P1);
    the content halves and the freedom after is 2^b'. Then at least one bit arrives in the freedom, and the heat
    it carries at temperature T is at least k_B T ln 2. Boltzmann's form is not imported: the logarithm is forced
    by additivity (`bits_forced`), k_B and ln 2 are units, T is its definition, and P1 is the one posit. -/
theorem count_to_heat (L : List Nat) (step : Nat → Nat) (C C' b b' tkel : Nat) (hnd : ND L)
    (hwhole : L.length = C * 2 ^ b) (P1 : ∀ a ∈ L, ∀ x ∈ L, step a = step x → a = x)
    (cells : ∀ a ∈ L, step a < C' * 2 ^ b') (hhalf : C = 2 * C') (hpos : 0 < C') :
    b + 1 ≤ b' ∧ price tkel 1 ≤ price tkel (b' - b) := by
  have hd := export_doubles L step C (2 ^ b) C' (2 ^ b') hnd hwhole P1 cells hhalf hpos
  have hb := one_bit_arrives b b' hd
  exact ⟨hb, price_monotone tkel 1 (b' - b) (by omega)⟩

/-- P1 IS LOAD-BEARING. A step that merges two states lets the content halve with no freedom exported:
    two whole states, both sent to one cell, content 2 → 1, freedom 1 → 1. -/
theorem merge_exports_nothing :
    [0, 1].length = 2 * 2 ^ 0 ∧ (∀ a ∈ [0, 1], (fun _ : Nat => 0) a < 1 * 2 ^ 0) ∧
    ¬ (∀ a ∈ [0, 1], ∀ x ∈ [0, 1], (fun _ : Nat => (0 : Nat)) a = (fun _ : Nat => (0 : Nat)) x → a = x) := by
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a _; show 0 < 1 * 2 ^ 0; decide
  · intro h; exact absurd (h 0 (List.Mem.head _) 1 (List.Mem.tail _ (List.Mem.head _)) rfl) (by decide)

end Heat

#print axioms Heat.pigeonhole
#print axioms Heat.additive_is_linear_on_tower
#print axioms Heat.log_unique_up_to_unit
#print axioms Heat.bits_forced
#print axioms Heat.export_doubles
#print axioms Heat.one_bit_arrives
#print axioms Heat.count_to_heat
#print axioms Heat.merge_exports_nothing
~~~~~

### The_Loop.lean

~~~~~lean file=The_Loop.lean
/-
  THE LOOP · the record closes, the value stays. Core Lean 4.19.0, standalone, no library, no axiom declared.
  Chart-free. There is no strip in this file, because there is no strip: the width is not an invariant of the
  plane's own motions (sPSP-TOPOS-01, the Annihilation Theorem), the middle is not furniture, and the hypothesis
  with its metric tokens deleted reads ρ = σ(ρ), a fixed-point claim over a discrete set. What stands is the fold
  and its fixed set, T1 of sPSP-TOPOS-02, and nothing else is used here: an involution σ on any type, its fixed set,
  a registration that lands on the fixed set, fixes it and forgets the side of an orbit.
  On the physical side there was never a strip either: charge conjugation is an involution on charges, its fixed set
  is the neutral state, and a charged particle with its antiparticle is a two-point orbit, not a location.
  I   The seat: on the fixed set the two blind spots cancel; off it the orbit is a pair and no registration shows it.
  II  The carrier: an equivariant map sends the neutral states to the fixed set and, if injective, a charged pair to
      a two-point orbit. The address is not geometric: any involution, any carrier (sPSP-TOPOS-02).
  III The deed: registration of the pair lands on the fixed set and forgets which member it was.
  IV  The price: under P1, the whole merges no two states, the forgotten member is exported as one bit, priced
      at k_B T ln 2 (constants as in Armed_Seat and Heat_Bridge).
  V   The value: whether a world lies in the fixed set is not read by the record. For every point off the fixed set,
      the pair world and its registered world leave one record, the fixed-point claim holds on one and fails on the
      other, and no reading of the record decides it. The value is the keyed bit, elected by the object (for ζ, by
      its functional equation), never by a width.
  VI  The instance on charges, no strip anywhere: σ q = −q on the integers, fixed set {0}, the electron's orbit {−1, 1}.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace Loop

/-! ## I · the fold, its fixed set, a registration -/
/-- A fold: an involution on any type. No metric, no chart, no width. -/
structure Fold (X : Type) where
  σ : X → X
  invol : ∀ x, σ (σ x) = x

def Fixed {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (x : X) : Prop := F.σ x = x

/-- A registration: it lands on the fixed set, fixes what is already there, and forgets the side of an orbit. -/
structure Registration {X : Type} (F : Fold X) where
  r : X → X
  lands : ∀ x, Fixed F (r x)
  fixes : ∀ x, Fixed F x → r x = x
  forgets : ∀ x, r (F.σ x) = r x

/-- THE SEAT. On the fixed set a point is its own partner, its own record, and a registered point. -/
theorem seat_cancels {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (R : Registration F) (x : X) (h : Fixed F x) :
    F.σ x = x ∧ R.r x = x ∧ ∃ w, R.r w = x :=
  ⟨h, R.fixes x h, ⟨x, R.fixes x h⟩⟩

/-- OFF THE SEAT. The fold moves the point, the record forgets its side, and no registration shows it. -/
theorem off_seat_unregistered {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (R : Registration F) (x : X) (h : ¬ Fixed F x) :
    F.σ x ≠ x ∧ R.r (F.σ x) = R.r x ∧ ∀ w, R.r w ≠ x :=
  ⟨h, R.forgets x, fun w hw => h (hw ▸ R.lands w)⟩

/-- An orbit off the fixed set is a pair: its partner is distinct and also off the fixed set. -/
theorem off_seat_pair {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (x : X) (h : ¬ Fixed F x) : F.σ x ≠ x ∧ ¬ Fixed F (F.σ x) := by
  refine ⟨h, fun h2 => h ?_⟩
  have e : F.σ (F.σ x) = F.σ x := h2
  rw [F.invol x] at e
  exact e.symm

/-! ## II · the carrier -/
/-- A carrier: a map from physical states with their own involution, commuting with the folds. -/
structure Carrier {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (S : Type) (C : Fold S) where
  φ : S → X
  equivariant : ∀ p, φ (C.σ p) = F.σ (φ p)

/-- Neutral states land on the fixed set: the fixed set is a functor. -/
theorem neutral_lands_fixed {X S : Type} (F : Fold X) (C : Fold S) (K : Carrier F S C) (p : S)
    (h : Fixed C p) : Fixed F (K.φ p) := by
  show F.σ (K.φ p) = K.φ p
  rw [← K.equivariant p, h]

/-- An injective carrier sends a charged pair to a two-point orbit off the fixed set. -/
theorem charged_pair_is_orbit {X S : Type} (F : Fold X) (C : Fold S) (K : Carrier F S C)
    (inj : ∀ p q, K.φ p = K.φ q → p = q) (p : S) (h : ¬ Fixed C p) :
    ¬ Fixed F (K.φ p) ∧ K.φ (C.σ p) = F.σ (K.φ p) ∧ K.φ (C.σ p) ≠ K.φ p := by
  refine ⟨fun hf => h (inj _ _ ((K.equivariant p).trans hf)), K.equivariant p, fun e => h (inj _ _ e)⟩

/-! ## III · the deed -/
/-- THE DEED. Registering either member of the pair lands on the fixed set, and the two records are one. -/
theorem deed_forgets_member {X S : Type} (F : Fold X) (R : Registration F) (C : Fold S) (K : Carrier F S C)
    (p : S) : Fixed F (R.r (K.φ p)) ∧ R.r (K.φ (C.σ p)) = R.r (K.φ p) := by
  refine ⟨R.lands _, ?_⟩
  rw [K.equivariant p]
  exact R.forgets _

/-! ## IV · the price -/
def ND : List Nat → Prop
  | [] => True
  | x :: r => x ∉ r ∧ ND r

def AllLt (M : Nat) : List Nat → Prop
  | [] => True
  | x :: r => x < M ∧ AllLt M r

theorem allLt_mem (M : Nat) : ∀ (l : List Nat) (y : Nat), AllLt M l → y ∈ l → y < M
  | [], _, _, m => nomatch m
  | x :: r, y, h, m => by
    cases m with
    | head => exact h.1
    | tail _ hm => exact allLt_mem M r y h.2 hm

theorem nd_map (h : Nat → Nat) : ∀ l : List Nat, ND l → (∀ a ∈ l, ∀ b ∈ l, h a = h b → a = b) → ND (l.map h)
  | [], _, _ => trivial
  | x :: r, hnd, hinj => by
    refine ⟨fun m => ?_, nd_map h r hnd.2 (fun a ha b hb e => hinj a (List.Mem.tail x ha) b (List.Mem.tail x hb) e)⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, e⟩ := List.mem_map.mp m
    have : y = x := hinj y (List.Mem.tail x hy) x (List.Mem.head r) e
    exact hnd.1 (this ▸ hy)

theorem allLt_map (h : Nat → Nat) (M : Nat) : ∀ l : List Nat, (∀ a ∈ l, h a < M) → AllLt M (l.map h)
  | [], _ => trivial
  | x :: r, hb => ⟨hb x (List.Mem.head r), allLt_map h M r (fun a ha => hb a (List.Mem.tail x ha))⟩

theorem pigeonhole_rec : ∀ (l : List Nat) (M : Nat), ND l → AllLt M l → l.length ≤ M
  | [], _, _, _ => Nat.zero_le _
  | x :: r, M, hnd, hlt => by
    have hx : x < M := hlt.1
    let sw : Nat → Nat := fun y => if y = M - 1 then x else y
    have hbound : ∀ a ∈ r, sw a < M - 1 := by
      intro a ha
      have haM := allLt_mem M r a hlt.2 ha
      have hax : a ≠ x := fun e => hnd.1 (e ▸ ha)
      show (if a = M - 1 then x else a) < M - 1
      by_cases e : a = M - 1
      · rw [if_pos e]
        have : x ≠ M - 1 := fun e2 => hax (e.trans e2.symm)
        omega
      · rw [if_neg e]; omega
    have hinj : ∀ a ∈ r, ∀ b ∈ r, sw a = sw b → a = b := by
      intro a ha b hb e
      have hax : a ≠ x := fun e2 => hnd.1 (e2 ▸ ha)
      have hbx : b ≠ x := fun e2 => hnd.1 (e2 ▸ hb)
      change (if a = M - 1 then x else a) = (if b = M - 1 then x else b) at e
      by_cases ea : a = M - 1 <;> by_cases eb : b = M - 1
      · rw [ea, eb]
      · rw [if_pos ea, if_neg eb] at e; exact absurd e.symm hbx
      · rw [if_neg ea, if_pos eb] at e; exact absurd e hax
      · rw [if_neg ea, if_neg eb] at e; exact e
    have ih := pigeonhole_rec (r.map sw) (M - 1) (nd_map sw r hnd.2 hinj) (allLt_map sw (M - 1) r hbound)
    rw [List.length_map] at ih
    show r.length + 1 ≤ M
    omega

theorem pigeonhole : ∀ (l : List Nat) (M : Nat), ND l → AllLt M l → l.length ≤ M :=
  fun l M hnd hlt => pigeonhole_rec l M hnd hlt

/-- THE MEMBER IS EXPORTED. The two members are two distinct whole states; if the step merges nothing (P1) and one
    neutral cell remains as content, the freedom elsewhere is at least two: one bit. -/
theorem member_exported (L : List Nat) (step : Nat → Nat) (F' : Nat) (hnd : ND L) (hlen : L.length = 2)
    (P1 : ∀ a ∈ L, ∀ b ∈ L, step a = step b → a = b) (cells : ∀ a ∈ L, step a < 1 * F') : 2 ≤ F' := by
  have h := pigeonhole (L.map step) (1 * F') (nd_map step L hnd P1) (allLt_map step _ L cells)
  rw [List.length_map, hlen, Nat.one_mul] at h
  exact h

/-- Without P1 the member is merged away at no export: P1 is load-bearing. -/
theorem merge_forgets_for_free :
    [0, 1].length = 2 ∧ (∀ a ∈ [0, 1], (fun _ : Nat => (0 : Nat)) a < 1 * 1) ∧
    ¬ (∀ a ∈ [0, 1], ∀ b ∈ [0, 1], (fun _ : Nat => (0 : Nat)) a = (fun _ : Nat => (0 : Nat)) b → a = b) := by
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a _; show 0 < 1 * 1; decide
  · intro h; exact absurd (h 0 (List.Mem.head _) 1 (List.Mem.tail _ (List.Mem.head _)) rfl) (by decide)

/-- k_B T ln 2 per bit in units of 10⁻⁴⁵ J: k_B exact (SI 2019), ln 2 to sixteen digits, T in kelvin. -/
def price (tkel bits : Nat) : Nat := bits * 1380649 * tkel * 6931471805599453

theorem member_priced : price 300 1 = 2870978885078723755499100 ∧ ∀ t, 0 < t → 0 < price t 1 := by
  refine ⟨by decide, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  unfold price
  exact Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos (by decide) ht) (by decide)

/-! ## V · the value: the fixed-point claim is keyed -/
/-- The value on a world: every member is fixed by the fold. This is the hypothesis with its metric deleted. -/
def AllFixed {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (Z : X → Prop) : Prop := ∀ x, Z x → Fixed F x

def SameRecord {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (Z Z' : X → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ y, (∃ s, Z s ∧ R.r s = y) ↔ (∃ s, Z' s ∧ R.r s = y)

/-- For any point off the fixed set: its orbit world and its registered world leave one record. -/
theorem one_record {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (R : Registration F) (x : X) :
    SameRecord R (fun s => s = R.r x) (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x) := by
  intro y
  constructor
  · intro ⟨s, hs, hy⟩
    refine ⟨x, Or.inl rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [← hy, hs, R.fixes _ (R.lands x)]
  · intro ⟨s, hs, hy⟩
    refine ⟨R.r x, rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [R.fixes _ (R.lands x), ← hy]
    rcases hs with h | h
    · rw [h]
    · rw [h, R.forgets]

theorem worlds_differ {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (R : Registration F) (x : X) (h : ¬ Fixed F x) :
    AllFixed F (fun s => s = R.r x) ∧ ¬ AllFixed F (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x) :=
  ⟨fun _ hs => hs ▸ R.lands x, fun hall => h (hall x (Or.inl rfl))⟩

/-- THE VALUE STAYS. No reading that respects the record returns the fixed-point claim on both worlds. -/
theorem record_decides_nothing {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (R : Registration F) (x : X) (h : ¬ Fixed F x)
    (g : (X → Prop) → Prop) (hg : ∀ Z Z', SameRecord R Z Z' → (g Z ↔ g Z')) :
    ¬ ((g (fun s => s = R.r x) ↔ AllFixed F (fun s => s = R.r x)) ∧
       (g (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x) ↔ AllFixed F (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x))) := by
  intro ⟨h1, h2⟩
  exact (worlds_differ F R x h).2 (h2.mp ((hg _ _ (one_record F R x)).mp (h1.mpr (worlds_differ F R x h).1)))

/-! ## VI · the instance on charges: no strip anywhere -/
def conj : Fold Int := ⟨fun q => -q, fun q => Int.neg_neg q⟩
def toNeutral : Registration conj :=
  ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ => by show -(0 : Int) = 0; decide, fun x h => by
    have e : -x = x := h
    show (0 : Int) = x
    omega, fun _ => rfl⟩
def selfCarrier : Carrier conj Int conj := ⟨fun q => q, fun _ => rfl⟩

/-- On charges the fixed set is the neutral state and nothing else. -/
theorem fixed_iff_neutral (q : Int) : Fixed conj q ↔ q = 0 := by
  show -q = q ↔ q = 0
  omega

/-- The electron and the positron are one two-point orbit, off the neutral state, and one record. -/
theorem electron_orbit :
    ¬ Fixed conj (-1) ∧ conj.σ (-1) = 1 ∧ toNeutral.r 1 = toNeutral.r (-1) ∧ Fixed conj (toNeutral.r (-1)) := by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, rfl, rfl, toNeutral.lands (-1)⟩
  have e : -(-1 : Int) = -1 := h
  omega

/-! ## VII · the loop, whole -/
/-- THE RECORD CLOSES, THE VALUE STAYS. For every fold, registration and carrier: the seat cancels both blind spots;
    off the seat the orbit is a pair no registration shows; neutral states land on the fixed set and an injective
    carrier sends a charged pair to such an orbit; the deed lands the pair on the fixed set and forgets the member;
    under P1 the member is exported as at least one bit, priced at k_B T ln 2; and for every point off the fixed set
    two worlds leave one record, the fixed-point claim true on one and false on the other, so no reading of the
    record decides it. No strip, no width and no address is used: the fold and its fixed set carry everything. -/
theorem record_closes_value_stays :
    (∀ {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (R : Registration F) (x : X), Fixed F x →
      F.σ x = x ∧ R.r x = x ∧ ∃ w, R.r w = x) ∧
    (∀ {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (R : Registration F) (x : X), ¬ Fixed F x →
      F.σ x ≠ x ∧ R.r (F.σ x) = R.r x ∧ ∀ w, R.r w ≠ x) ∧
    (∀ {X S : Type} (F : Fold X) (C : Fold S) (K : Carrier F S C) (p : S), Fixed C p → Fixed F (K.φ p)) ∧
    (∀ {X S : Type} (F : Fold X) (C : Fold S) (K : Carrier F S C), (∀ p q, K.φ p = K.φ q → p = q) →
      ∀ p, ¬ Fixed C p → ¬ Fixed F (K.φ p) ∧ K.φ (C.σ p) = F.σ (K.φ p) ∧ K.φ (C.σ p) ≠ K.φ p) ∧
    (∀ {X S : Type} (F : Fold X) (R : Registration F) (C : Fold S) (K : Carrier F S C) (p : S),
      Fixed F (R.r (K.φ p)) ∧ R.r (K.φ (C.σ p)) = R.r (K.φ p)) ∧
    (∀ (L : List Nat) (step : Nat → Nat) (F' : Nat), ND L → L.length = 2 →
      (∀ a ∈ L, ∀ b ∈ L, step a = step b → a = b) → (∀ a ∈ L, step a < 1 * F') → 2 ≤ F') ∧
    price 300 1 = 2870978885078723755499100 ∧
    (∀ {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (R : Registration F) (x : X), ¬ Fixed F x →
      SameRecord R (fun s => s = R.r x) (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x) ∧
      AllFixed F (fun s => s = R.r x) ∧ ¬ AllFixed F (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x)) ∧
    (∀ {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (R : Registration F) (x : X), ¬ Fixed F x →
      ∀ g : (X → Prop) → Prop, (∀ Z Z', SameRecord R Z Z' → (g Z ↔ g Z')) →
      ¬ ((g (fun s => s = R.r x) ↔ AllFixed F (fun s => s = R.r x)) ∧
         (g (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x) ↔ AllFixed F (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x)))) ∧
    (¬ Fixed conj (-1) ∧ conj.σ (-1) = 1 ∧ toNeutral.r 1 = toNeutral.r (-1) ∧ Fixed conj (toNeutral.r (-1))) :=
  ⟨fun F R x h => seat_cancels F R x h, fun F R x h => off_seat_unregistered F R x h,
   fun F C K p h => neutral_lands_fixed F C K p h, fun F C K inj p h => charged_pair_is_orbit F C K inj p h,
   fun F R C K p => deed_forgets_member F R C K p, member_exported, member_priced.1,
   fun F R x h => ⟨one_record F R x, worlds_differ F R x h⟩,
   fun F R x h g hg => record_decides_nothing F R x h g hg, electron_orbit⟩


/-! ## VIII · the strip vanishes from every registration, both flanks at once -/
/-- The value read as monism: every zero is its own record. This is the fixed-point claim and nothing weaker. -/
theorem zero_monism_is_value {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (R : Registration F) (Z : X → Prop) :
    (∀ s, Z s → R.r s = s) ↔ AllFixed F Z :=
  ⟨fun h s hs => (h s hs) ▸ R.lands s, fun h s hs => R.fixes s (h s hs)⟩

/-- THE FLANKS TOGETHER. On a fold-closed world a member off the fixed set brings its partner, distinct and also
    off it: the two flanks are populated together, never one. -/
theorem flanks_together {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (Z : X → Prop) (hZ : ∀ x, Z x → Z (F.σ x)) (x : X)
    (hx : Z x) (h : ¬ Fixed F x) : Z (F.σ x) ∧ F.σ x ≠ x ∧ ¬ Fixed F (F.σ x) :=
  ⟨hZ x hx, (off_seat_pair F x h).1, (off_seat_pair F x h).2⟩

/-- THE LANDING IS NOT A MOVING. The pair world registers wholly onto the fixed set and is not itself fixed:
    registration closes the record and leaves the world where it stands. -/
theorem landing_is_not_moving {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (R : Registration F) (x : X) (h : ¬ Fixed F x) :
    (∀ s, (s = x ∨ s = F.σ x) → Fixed F (R.r s)) ∧ ¬ AllFixed F (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x) :=
  ⟨fun s _ => R.lands s, (worlds_differ F R x h).2⟩

/-- Time: each tick writes the record from the zero and carries the zero along unmoved. -/
structure World (X : Type) where
  zero : X
  record : X

def tick {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) (w : World X) : World X := ⟨w.zero, R.r w.zero⟩

def run {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) : Nat → World X → World X
  | 0, w => w
  | n + 1, w => run R n (tick R w)

theorem run_zero {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (w : World X), (run R n w).zero = w.zero := by
  intro n; induction n with
  | zero => intro w; rfl
  | succ k ih => intro w; show (run R k (tick R w)).zero = w.zero; rw [ih]; rfl

theorem run_record {X : Type} {F : Fold X} (R : Registration F) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (w : World X), (run R (n + 1) w).record = R.r w.zero := by
  intro n; induction n with
  | zero => intro w; rfl
  | succ k ih => intro w; show (run R (k + 1) (tick R w)).record = R.r w.zero; rw [ih]; rfl

/-- THE ACT MEETS THE BEING EXACTLY ON THE FIXED SET. Every record lies on it after the first tick, forever; the
    zero never moves; the two coincide at every time exactly when the zero is fixed. -/
theorem act_meets_being_iff {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (R : Registration F) (w : World X) :
    (∀ n, Fixed F (run R (n + 1) w).record) ∧ (∀ n, (run R n w).zero = w.zero) ∧
    ((∀ n, (run R (n + 1) w).record = (run R (n + 1) w).zero) ↔ Fixed F w.zero) := by
  refine ⟨fun n => by rw [run_record]; exact R.lands _, fun n => run_zero R n w, ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h n => ?_⟩⟩
  · have h0 := h 0
    rw [run_record, run_zero] at h0
    exact h0 ▸ R.lands w.zero
  · rw [run_record, run_zero]; exact R.fixes _ h

/-- TIME DOES NOT FORCE THE MEETING. A zero off the fixed set is recorded on it forever and never arrives there. -/
theorem time_does_not_collapse {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (R : Registration F) (x : X) (h : ¬ Fixed F x) :
    (∀ n, Fixed F (run R (n + 1) ⟨x, x⟩).record) ∧ ∀ n, ¬ Fixed F (run R n ⟨x, x⟩).zero :=
  ⟨fun n => (act_meets_being_iff F R ⟨x, x⟩).1 n, fun n hf => h (by rw [run_zero] at hf; exact hf)⟩

/-! ## IX · the instance on the ζ chart: the strip, both flanks, vanishes from every registration -/
/-- The chart of One_Cut_Resolution at resolution ten, the grid of the twin: x = 20·Re s, height t, the fold
    s ↦ 1 − s̄ as x ↦ 20 − x, the line x = 10. Chart only; the verdicts do not depend on it
    (Forced.chart_verdict_invariant). At resolution one the open interior holds no point off the line
    (OneCutRes.coarse_strip_is_the_line); that is a fact of the coarse grid, not of ζ, so the finer chart is used. -/
def zetaFold : Fold (Int × Nat) := ⟨fun p => (20 - p.1, p.2), fun p => by
  obtain ⟨x, t⟩ := p
  show (20 - (20 - x), t) = (x, t)
  rw [Int.sub_sub_self]⟩

theorem zeta_fixed_iff (p : Int × Nat) : Fixed zetaFold p ↔ p.1 = 10 := by
  obtain ⟨x, t⟩ := p
  show (20 - x, t) = (x, t) ↔ x = 10
  constructor
  · intro h
    have e : 20 - x = x := congrArg Prod.fst h
    omega
  · intro h
    subst h
    rfl

def zetaReg : Registration zetaFold :=
  ⟨fun p => (10, p.2), fun _ => rfl, fun p h => by
    obtain ⟨x, t⟩ := p
    have e : x = 10 := (zeta_fixed_iff (x, t)).mp h
    subst e
    rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩

/-- THE STRIP VANISHES, BOTH FLANKS. Every point of either flank registers onto the line at its own height; a point
    left of the line has its partner right of it, and the two register to one record. No registration of anything
    stands off the line. -/
theorem strip_vanishes_both_flanks (p : Int × Nat) :
    Fixed zetaFold (zetaReg.r p) ∧ (zetaReg.r p).2 = p.2 ∧
    (p.1 < 10 → 10 < (zetaFold.σ p).1 ∧ zetaReg.r (zetaFold.σ p) = zetaReg.r p) ∧
    (10 < p.1 → (zetaFold.σ p).1 < 10 ∧ zetaReg.r (zetaFold.σ p) = zetaReg.r p) ∧
    ∀ q : Int × Nat, zetaReg.r q ≠ p ∨ p.1 = 10 := by
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, fun h => ⟨show 10 < 20 - p.1 by omega, rfl⟩, fun h => ⟨show 20 - p.1 < 10 by omega, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  intro q
  by_cases e : p.1 = 10
  · exact Or.inr e
  · exact Or.inl (fun hq => e (hq ▸ rfl))

/-- AND THE VALUE STAYS ON THE CHART TOO: the interior pair at real parts 0.4 and 0.6, strictly inside and off the line,
    registers wholly onto the line and is not on it. -/
theorem zeta_pair_stays : (∀ s, (s = ((8 : Int), 14) ∨ s = zetaFold.σ (8, 14)) → Fixed zetaFold (zetaReg.r s)) ∧
    ¬ AllFixed zetaFold (fun s => s = ((8 : Int), 14) ∨ s = zetaFold.σ (8, 14)) :=
  landing_is_not_moving zetaFold zetaReg (8, 14) (fun h => absurd ((zeta_fixed_iff _).mp h) (by decide))

/-! ## X · what can contradict the value, and what cannot -/
/-- ONE MEMBER REFUTES. A single member of a world not fixed by the fold refutes the fixed-point claim on that world:
    F-Computed is a refuter, and the only shape a refutation can take. -/
theorem one_member_refutes {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (Z : X → Prop) (x : X) (hz : Z x) (h : ¬ Fixed F x) :
    ¬ AllFixed F Z :=
  fun hall => h (hall x hz)

/-- TRUTH IS UNREFUTABLE, CONDITIONALLY. If the fixed-point claim holds on a world, no member of it is off the fixed
    set, so no computation ever exhibits one. This is the whole content of immutability, and it is conditional on the
    value: it does not supply the value. -/
theorem truth_is_unrefutable {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (Z : X → Prop) (hv : AllFixed F Z) :
    ¬ ∃ x, Z x ∧ ¬ Fixed F x :=
  fun ⟨x, hz, h⟩ => h (hv x hz)

/-- A WITNESS TRUE ON THE PAIR FORCES NOTHING. Any reading of worlds that holds on the pair world, a law of physics, a
    measured unitarity, a floor price, a carrier's landing, cannot force the fixed-point claim: the pair world satisfies
    it and fails the claim. -/
theorem witness_forces_nothing {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (x : X) (h : ¬ Fixed F x) (W : (X → Prop) → Prop)
    (hW : W (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x)) : ¬ ∀ Z, W Z → AllFixed F Z :=
  fun hall => h (hall _ hW x (Or.inl rfl))

/-- PHYSICS FORCES NOTHING. Every true proposition that does not mention the zeros, every fact of nature, holds on the
    pair world as on any other, so none of them forces the claim wherever a point off the fixed set exists. -/
theorem physics_forces_nothing {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (x : X) (h : ¬ Fixed F x) (P : Prop) (hp : P) :
    ¬ ∀ Z : X → Prop, P → AllFixed F Z :=
  fun hall => h (hall (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x) hp x (Or.inl rfl))

/-! ## X · the loop, final -/
/-- THE LOOP, FINAL. The record closes: every registration of every point lands on the fixed set, both flanks together
    and at one record, forever in time, on every fold and on the ζ chart. The value stays: registration moves nothing,
    time forces no meeting, act meets being exactly on the fixed set, the value is the fixed-point claim, and no reading
    of the record decides it. One member off the fixed set refutes the claim, a true claim is never refuted, and no
    fact that holds on the pair world, no fact of physics, forces it. The strip is absent from every record by theorem;
    its absence from the zero set is the one keyed bit. -/
theorem loop_final :
    (∀ {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (R : Registration F) (Z : X → Prop), (∀ s, Z s → R.r s = s) ↔ AllFixed F Z) ∧
    (∀ {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (Z : X → Prop), (∀ x, Z x → Z (F.σ x)) → ∀ x, Z x → ¬ Fixed F x →
      Z (F.σ x) ∧ F.σ x ≠ x ∧ ¬ Fixed F (F.σ x)) ∧
    (∀ {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (R : Registration F) (x : X), ¬ Fixed F x →
      (∀ s, (s = x ∨ s = F.σ x) → Fixed F (R.r s)) ∧ ¬ AllFixed F (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x)) ∧
    (∀ {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (R : Registration F) (w : World X),
      (∀ n, Fixed F (run R (n + 1) w).record) ∧ (∀ n, (run R n w).zero = w.zero) ∧
      ((∀ n, (run R (n + 1) w).record = (run R (n + 1) w).zero) ↔ Fixed F w.zero)) ∧
    (∀ {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (R : Registration F) (x : X), ¬ Fixed F x →
      (∀ n, Fixed F (run R (n + 1) ⟨x, x⟩).record) ∧ ∀ n, ¬ Fixed F (run R n ⟨x, x⟩).zero) ∧
    (∀ p : Int × Nat, Fixed zetaFold (zetaReg.r p) ∧ (zetaReg.r p).2 = p.2 ∧
      (p.1 < 10 → 10 < (zetaFold.σ p).1 ∧ zetaReg.r (zetaFold.σ p) = zetaReg.r p) ∧
      (10 < p.1 → (zetaFold.σ p).1 < 10 ∧ zetaReg.r (zetaFold.σ p) = zetaReg.r p) ∧
      ∀ q : Int × Nat, zetaReg.r q ≠ p ∨ p.1 = 10) ∧
    ((∀ s, (s = ((8 : Int), 14) ∨ s = zetaFold.σ (8, 14)) → Fixed zetaFold (zetaReg.r s)) ∧
      ¬ AllFixed zetaFold (fun s => s = ((8 : Int), 14) ∨ s = zetaFold.σ (8, 14))) ∧
    (∀ {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (R : Registration F) (x : X), ¬ Fixed F x →
      ∀ g : (X → Prop) → Prop, (∀ Z Z', SameRecord R Z Z' → (g Z ↔ g Z')) →
      ¬ ((g (fun s => s = R.r x) ↔ AllFixed F (fun s => s = R.r x)) ∧
         (g (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x) ↔ AllFixed F (fun s => s = x ∨ s = F.σ x)))) ∧
    (∀ {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (Z : X → Prop) (x : X), Z x → ¬ Fixed F x → ¬ AllFixed F Z) ∧
    (∀ {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (Z : X → Prop), AllFixed F Z → ¬ ∃ x, Z x ∧ ¬ Fixed F x) ∧
    (∀ {X : Type} (F : Fold X) (x : X), ¬ Fixed F x → ∀ (P : Prop), P → ¬ ∀ Z : X → Prop, P → AllFixed F Z) :=
  ⟨fun F R Z => zero_monism_is_value F R Z, fun F Z hZ x hx h => flanks_together F Z hZ x hx h,
   fun F R x h => landing_is_not_moving F R x h, fun F R w => act_meets_being_iff F R w,
   fun F R x h => time_does_not_collapse F R x h, strip_vanishes_both_flanks, zeta_pair_stays,
   fun F R x h g hg => record_decides_nothing F R x h g hg,
   fun F Z x hz h => one_member_refutes F Z x hz h, fun F Z hv => truth_is_unrefutable F Z hv,
   fun F x h P hp => physics_forces_nothing F x h P hp⟩

end Loop
